name: @role-orchestrator/implicit-verify
description: M4-06 CLI implicit-config and proxy-budget verification (A34/A35). Pure-verification package with NO product logic and NO CLI invocation: it pins the A35 control plane (unattended write refused while implicit loading is unverified; scheduler quota/budget/usage ledgers count only orchestrator-dispatched executions, so CLI-internal sub-agent/MCP activity is never billable) and the A34 extension (external host-config drift detected pre-start and refused; frozen run snapshots never implicitly swap mid-run).
